name: Ticket Tailor
description: Ticket Tailor is a ticketing platform for creating event pages, selling tickets, managing box-office operations, issuing tickets, checking guests in and running memberships, waitlists and related sales workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect a least-privilege customer-owned Ticket Tailor key through Railway's encrypted boundary, then let selected agents list one bounded event page or inspect one exact event without attendee, order or financial data.

credentialRequirements.name: TICKET_TAILOR_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Ticket Tailor API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a key with only the events endpoints selected and keep Hide personal data enabled.

capabilities.label: Read event metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Ticket Tailor event summaries and inspect one exact event without people, orders or financial data.

allowed.label: List events
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five Ticket Tailor event summaries from the first cursor page.

allowed.label: Read an event
allowed.description: Read one exact Ticket Tailor event metadata summary.

blocked.label: Block people and financial data
blocked.description: Orders, buyers, issued tickets, memberships, waitlists, check-ins, barcodes, payments, reports and personal data are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block ticketing mutations
blocked.description: Event, series, ticket, order, discount, voucher, product, membership, hold, waitlist and check-in writes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw API access
blocked.description: Arbitrary REST or MCP tools, cursor traversal, bulk operations and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded event reads run directly; people, financial, ticketing writes, cursor traversal and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; key scope, fixed origin, bounds and redaction still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed Ticket Tailor event reads and sends the encrypted least-privilege key only to the fixed API origin.
Relay mounts two typed Ticket Tailor event reads and sends the encrypted least-privilege key only to the fixed API origin.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer generates a box-office API key with only event endpoints selected and Hide personal data enabled, enters it in Relay, then selects event-read capability and Safe or Dangerous policy per agent install.

evidence.supports: Ticket Tailor documents HTTPS JSON at api.tickettailor.com, box-office-bound API keys, Basic authentication, cursor pagination, a 100-item provider maximum and rate-limit response headers.
Ticket Tailor documents first-page event listing with limit and cursor parameters and exact event resources under /v1/events.
Ticket Tailor states the API is available to all users and lets a box-office owner generate a key while selecting the endpoints it may access.
Ticket Tailor recommends keeping Hide personal data enabled when connecting an API key to an AI assistant.
